stable.notes: The three bundled Jedi besides Miles Windu carried an Advanced badge while standing perfectly still, because each maps one image onto all ten states. A character with no authored animation for a state now shifts its weight: it bobs on the feet, leans, and takes a small step. The motion gets faster and wider as sessions stack up, so two, three, and four or more sessions still read off the figure itself. The same cadence covers every OpenPets still and any single PNG you drop on the pet. Miles Windu is untouched, because his states carry real authored animation already. Resting states stay still, and Reduce Motion turns the cadence off. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
